notes.title: Release V1.2.9
notes.content: Fixed security issue on load of VBOX Sim

notes.title: Release V1.2.5
notes.content:
[h3]New Features[/h3]
[list]
[*]F1 23 and F1 24 support
[*]KartKraft support added
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where the VBOX LapTimer did not recognise the start/finish line in some circumstances
[/list]

notes.title: Release V1.1.25
notes.content:
[h3]New Features[/h3]
[list]
[*]F1 2022 support.
[*]Manual game selection: In the help tab "Game Select" dropdown has been added which will force VBOX Sim to only look for that game.
[*]Custom telemetry port for Codemasters games: If a game from the F1 series is selected with manual game selection an option to change the UDP port used to communicate will be shown as a means of providing compatibility with other applications interacting with them.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed a couple of issues relating to data received from Assetto Corsa Competizione.
[*]Fixed a couple of issues where the detected game would repeatedly switch causing logging to stop.
[*]Fixed a couple of issues around the handling of the iRacing data stream which could cause errors in logged data.
[*]Fixed several issues which could prevent a successful ibt vbo merge resulting in lower accuracy vbo data.
[*]Fixed several issues around communication with the VBOX LapTimer which could result in it not detecting a change in games, not receiving updates, or VBOX Sim logging stopping.
[*]Various stability improvements.
[/list]

notes.title: Release 1.0.63
notes.content:
We have released VBOX Sim 1.0.63, including the following:

RaceRoom is now supported.
F1 2021 is now supported.
OBS video capture option is now live. On some machine/display configurations this will provide a significant performance boost and added flexibility for video capture area, hardware acceleration options and more.
iRacing integration bug fixes.

We're keen to help: if you encounter issues then as ever, please contact us via email: simsupport@racelogic.co.uk and we will get you back up and running.

notes.title: OBS Support added
notes.content:
A new version is available via the 'public_test' branch. The primary new feature is support for OBS Studio as a method for video capture. On some machine/display configurations this will provide a significant performance boost and added flexibility for video capture area, hardware acceleration options and more.

To access the branch, right-click on VBOX Sim in your library, go to properties -> betas and select the 'public_test' beta. Steam should update VBOX Sim to v1.0.49 (you can see the version on the help tab in VBOX Sim).

Go to the 'help' tab in VBOX Sim and follow the instructions to download OBS Studio and install the OBS plugin - then get OBS setup as required (see the 'getting started' link on the Help tab), and change your video capture option to OBS.

If you encounter problems, please drop us an email at simsupport@racelogic.co.uk and we will get you up and running.

notes.title: iRacing now fully supported
notes.content:
We have released VBOX Sim v1.0.45, including full iRacing support.

Now, iRacing telemetry including accurate position is automatically integrated into VBOX Sim when a log file is completed.

Once VBOX Sim has stopped logging (when you finish a race or become stationary for 5 seconds), it will synchronize the vbo file with the iRacing telemetry file. The vbo can then be opened in Circuit Tools, where the track will be correctly identified and the map will show an accurate position.

iRacing telemetry files can get quite large, so by default we clear telemetry files that are more than one week old. It is possible to switch this off in the 'help' tab.

You may notice that there are 2 vbo files for a given video file for iRacing, both with the same name but on with a 'backup' suffix. This is the original vbo logged by VBOX Sim in case something goes wrong and you need to revert. This hasn't happened to us in our testing but is there just in case.

[h3]Circuit Tools v2.9[/h3]
VBOX Sim works best with Circuit Tools version 2.9.30 and above. Unfortunately, we discovered that the last release of VBOX Sim included circuit tools version 2.8.20, which will has issues with larger video files. This new version of VBOX Sim includes Circuit Tools 2.9.30, accessible via the help tab. NOTE: the Racelogic website has an earlier release so install from within VBOX Sim.

[h3]Known issues[/h3]
When using iRacing with the 'No Video' video capture option, the iRacing telemetry is not being integrated. We will soon be releasing a new version on the public beta branch with a fix.

[h3]OBS integration coming soon[/h3]
The next release will contain integration with OBS for video capture. On some machine/display configurations this will provide a significant performance boost. This will be available early Feb on the public beta branch. If you need OBS integration sooner, get in touch and we can arrange this.

[h3]Can't find your track?[/h3]
if you find a track that is not detected, it may not be in our circuit database. Use the request form on https://www.vboxmotorsport.co.uk/index.php/en/customer-ct-track-database and we'll do our best to add it.

[h3]Get in touch[/h3]
If you encounter issues then as ever, please contact us via email: simsupport@racelogic.co.uk and we will endeavour to get you back up and running.

notes.title: iRacing now fully supported in beta branch
notes.content:
We have released VBOX Sim v1.0.42, including full iRacing support to the 'Public Test' branch.

We are still testing this version internally - but so far testing has been positive. Therefore we would like to offer this version to sim racers that are keen to start using VBOX Sim with full iRacing support over the festive period.

To access the public test branch, right click on VBOX Sim in your library and go to properties then the 'betas' tab. Select the 'public beta testing' beta. Steam should then update VBOX Sim to this later version.

Now, iRacing's 'telemetry' is automatically started and stopped when VBOX Sim starts/stops logging data/recording video.

Once VBOX Sim has stopped logging (when you finish a race or become stationary for 5 seconds), it will synchronize the vbo file with the accurate position in the iRacing telemetry file. The vbo can then be opened in Circuit Tools, where the track will be correctly identified and the map will show an accurate position.

iRacing telemetry files can get quite large, so by default we clear telemetry files that are more than one week old. It is possible to switch this off in the 'help' tab.

You may notice that there are 2 vbo files for a given video file for iRacing, both with the same name but on with a 'backup' suffix. This is the original vbo logged by VBOX Sim in case something goes wrong and you need to revert. This hasn't happened to us in our testing but is there just in case.

If you encounter issues then please contact us via email: simsupport@racelogic.co.uk

notes.title: Release v1.0.29 now available
notes.content:
F1 2020 support has been added. Please ensure that UDP format is set to "2020" in game settings.

A new 'Game Select' feature has been added on the 'Help' tab. This is only for use in rare situations where VBOX Sim is receiving game data from 2 games simultaneously - usually when the previously used game didn't close properly - causing empty vbo and video files to be created as VBOX Sim switches between games. Unless you encounter problems like this no need to change this from the default  setting.

We are still working on iRacing - we hope to release a version with full iRacing support before the end of the year.

If you do encounter issues we are keen to help - please get in touch at simsupport@racelogic.co.uk with a description of the issue.
